_comment: Scrap cost added (CR 8.3.32). 'If it scrapped a HYPER DRIVER' asks what was SCRAPPED, not merely that this card scrapped — so SCRAPPED takes `name`, and the scrap cost records both identities (this card's slug and the scrapped card's slug/name). Was the invented flag 'SCRAPPED_HYPER_DRIVER'. Scrap is authored as the CARD-LEVEL `cost` (a play-time additional cost) rather than a separate empty PLAY ability: an ability existing only to carry a cost has no effects, which is a no-op by the hygiene rule and rightly flagged. Card-level `cost` compiles to play_cost, which engine/play.py checks and pays.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.
